subject: Renewal: option to simplify billing via AWS Marketplace (Harbor Retail)
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@harborretail.com>, Chris Taylor <ctaylor@harborretail.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: option to simplify billing via AWS Marketplace (Harbor Retail)

Hi Emma / Chris —

Hope you’re both well. Harbor’s annual subscription is up for renewal on 2028-06-30. To make procurement and invoicing simpler for your finance team, we’d like to propose converting your current direct contract to an AWS Marketplace subscription. High-level benefits: 

- Single consolidated invoice through your AWS account (reduces PO cycles)
- Maintains equivalent net economics (we can match the current committed rate)
- Enables co-sell pathways to accelerate feature rollout and priority support

Attached is a brief transition SOW that outlines the timeline and steps (we aim for a two-week technical and billing cutover once legal signs). If the Marketplace route looks ok, we’ll produce a Marketplace SKU mapping + amendment for signature (DocuSign).

Quick Qs for your side so we can get the right paperwork started: who in procurement should we route the order form to, and is there any internal procurement approval window we should factor in? 

cc: Sean (ops) for SKU/pricing alignment.

Thanks,

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Transition-SOW-Harbor-Redwood-v2.pdf (PDF, 52 KB)
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@harborretail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Chris Taylor <ctaylor@harborretail.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 11:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: option to simplify billing via AWS Marketplace (Harbor Retail)

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the note and the SOW. A couple quick points from procurement/finance: 

1) Pricing parity — can you confirm the per-unit/commit pricing will be the same after the move to AWS Marketplace? We need to show CFO that there’s no economic downside.
2) Invoice detail — our AP team requires invoice-level usage breakout for chargeback. Will AWS provide that level of granularity?
3) Contract term — our legal will need to confirm whether the Marketplace term will align with our current end date (2028-06-30) or if the Marketplace contract will default to vendor term lengths.

If those are okay, route the Marketplace order to me and I’ll hand off to our procurement lead (cc’d Chris) for final review.

Thanks,
Emma Jones
Senior Procurement Manager
Harbor Retail
emma.jones@harborretail.com | +1 617-555-0987
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@harborretail.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 May 2028 10:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: option to simplify billing via AWS Marketplace (Harbor Retail)

On Wed, May 22, 2028 at 11:04 AM Emma Jones <emma.jones@harborretail.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the note and the SOW. A couple quick points from procurement/finance: 
> 
> 1) Pricing parity — can you confirm the per-unit/commit pricing will be the same after the move to AWS Marketplace?
> 2) Invoice detail — our AP team requires invoice-level usage breakout for chargeback.
> 3) Contract term — will Marketplace term align with our current end date?

Hi Emma — quick answers from ops/finance: 

1) Pricing: We can honor the current committed effective rate for the remainder of your 2028 commitment. The Marketplace listing will include an equivalent SKU with a matched net price for the agreed term; any change of term beyond your renewal window will be subject to a standard Marketplace billing cadence (we will not auto-extend without your consent).

2) Invoicing: AWS invoices include SKU-level lines; for more granular daily usage we can provide a usage export (CSV) that your AP can ingest. We’ve attached a SKU mapping for your account to show the mapping from your current line items to Marketplace SKUs.

3) Term alignment: We will produce the amendment so the effective start date preserves your current term (i.e., no gap, no duplication) and will not change your renewal cadence unless you elect otherwise. Legal notes: the Marketplace amendment is a subscription purchase via AWS — it replaces the vendor invoice flow with Marketplace invoicing.

Next steps (proposed): 
- You confirm procurement lead and internal approvals window
- We provide the Marketplace order package + DocuSign link for Harbor to sign
- On signature, we coordinate with AWS seller-portal and schedule the engineering handoff (1–2 business days)

Attachments: Harbor-SKU-Mapping.csv (CSV, 18 KB)

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
From: Chris Taylor <ctaylor@harborretail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Jones <emma.jones@harborretail.com>
Date: Fri, 24 May 2028 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: option to simplify billing via AWS Marketplace (Harbor Retail)

Thanks — that all sounds reasonable. Procurement confirms they are happy to move to Marketplace provided the price parity and term alignment are preserved (per Sean). Please send the DocuSign amendment and the Marketplace order package and I’ll route it through our AP/legal for signature this week.

Chris Taylor
Director of Finance, Harbor Retail
ctaylor@harborretail.com | +1 617-555-0100

---
Looking forward to the DocuSign link. cc: Emma — I’ll coordinate on our side.
